prompt: How should the notebook record Nora’s results at Station 1?
promptZh: 諾拉在第一站的測試結果應如何記錄？

options.text: Keep two attempts: only the second met both reading requirements.
options.zh: 保留兩次測試；只有第二次達成兩項閱讀要求。
options.whyZh: 她第一次只讀出代碼，未完全通過；把標籤上移後兩項皆讀出。配置改變，兩次必須分別記載。

options.text: Keep two attempts: both met the requirements because the code was readable.
options.zh: 保留兩次測試；兩次都因代碼可讀而達標。
options.whyZh: 分開記錄正確，但只讀得出代碼不算完全通過。

options.text: Keep only the second attempt because it used the same holder.
options.zh: 只保留第二次，因為兩次都用同一個標籤架。
options.whyZh: 標籤架沒換，但把標籤上移改變了配置，先前那次仍要另外記。

options.text: Combine the attempts as one pass because Nora did not remove the label.
options.zh: 合併記為一次通過，因為諾拉沒有抽掉標籤。
options.whyZh: 標籤沒有抽掉不代表配置沒變；把標籤上移後要分開記錄，第一次也未完全通過。

explanationZh: 她第一次只讀出代碼，未完全通過；把標籤上移後兩項皆讀出。配置改變，兩次必須分別記載。
evidence: Reading the code correctly is not enough for a full pass. / If they changed the setup, the old attempt had to be logged separately. / A technician slid the label up and repeated the test, using the same holder. Nora then read both parts correctly.

evidenceSpans.exactQuote: Reading the code correctly is not enough for a full pass.
If they changed the setup, the old attempt had to be logged separately.
A technician slid the label up and repeated the test, using the same holder. Nora then read both parts correctly.

vocabulary.note: log 作動詞可指把一次測試或事件記入紀錄。
